subject: Dunning playbook: marketplace entity split & outstanding INV-7721
messages:
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: MarketSquare Billing <billing@marketsquare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Hi Olga / MarketSquare billing team,

Following up on INV-7721 (due 2028-05-30). Our system shows a partial remit posted to MarketSquare US entity but the marketplace split lines were omitted, so the net we received does not match the invoice. Attached: invoice PDF and the marketplace settlement log showing the mismatch.

Can you confirm:
- which legal entity submitted the payment instruction?
- whether the withholding/tax withhold (if any) was applied at source?
- expected date for the remaining balance to be released?

We try to avoid sending a formal dunning notice while treasury and your billing ops reconcile, but if we don’t have a confirmed remediation plan by EOD Thu (2028-06-22) we’ll need to initiate a canary dunning step to preserve cash recognition and trigger the next-level collections workflow.

Thanks,
Diego Fernández
Enterprise Accounts – North America
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: INV-7721.pdf (1 page), marketplace-settlement-log.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Olga S. <olga@marketsquare.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom R. <tom.recovery@marketsquare.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Hi Diego — sorry for the delay. We saw the remittance but the marketplace split was filed under MarketSquare EU entity by our payments partner; the payment engine incorrectly routed settlement metadata.

Steps we’re taking now:
- payments partner has queued a reallocation request (ref: PP-4582) to move funds to MarketSquare US by 2028-06-24 EOD.
- we will send a formal confirmation once reallocation completes and provide the ledger export.

If reallocation fails we can issue a manual top-up for the missing net amount. Apologies for the mix-up — we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Olga
Billing Ops — MarketSquare
From: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Olga S. <olga@marketsquare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Thanks Olga — appreciate the quick update. I’m looping in Finance (Marcus), Ops (Laura) and Legal (Stephanie) to align on two things:

1) If reallocation doesn’t land by COB 24-Jun, Finance will need an authorization to start the canary dunning message sequence targeted only at the billing contact (to avoid platform user churn).
2) If MarketSquare issues a manual top-up, we need a signed remittance confirmation and the ledger export to clear our GL entries (cc: Marcus).

Kimberly — can you confirm whether a canary dunning step (email + 3-day SLA notice) is ok for this account, or do you want executive review first?

Laura — please prepare the settlement reconciliation template (use the marketplace-settlement-log.xlsx attached in the thread) and leave placeholders for the remittance ID and reallocation ref.

Diego
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Diego — thanks for the heads up. Given the size of MKTSQ (ARR cadence + 60d overdue) and the marketplace routing error, we should authorize a single canary dunning email if the reallocation hasn’t posted by COB 24‑Jun. The canary should be non-accusatory and give a 72-hour payment window with a named customer success contact. If still unpaid after the 72-hour window, escalate to an exec touch: Marcus please prepare a short CFO note for a 1:1 with their CFO and copy me.

Marcus — please confirm the exact shortfall number you’ll use and whether we can accept a manual remit with ledger before initiating service impact.

Kimberly
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Kimberly — shortfall after reallocation (per Olga’s ledger preview) is $46,280. If MarketSquare provides the ledger export and remittance confirmation we can clear the GL without holding services. Accepting a manual top-up is OK; ask them to route funds to MarketSquare US (Entity ID: MSQ-US-01) and include the invoice reference (INV-7721).

I’ll draft a 1-paragraph CFO escalation note we can send if the canary window expires; Diego, Laura — please collect the reconciled spreadsheet and a screenshot of the failed allocation (PP-4582) to attach. Laura, I put a placeholder in the drive folder and added editing rights for the billing ops contact.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Olga S. <olga@marketsquare.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outstanding settlement INV-7721 and entity split clarification

Update: payments partner completed the reallocation at 14:22 PST (ref PP-4582). MarketSquare billing confirmed a top-up instruction is queued for release 2028-06-26 to cover the shortfall. I updated the marketplace-settlement-log.xlsx with the remittance ID and uploaded the ledger extract to the drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cD_marketplace-settlement

Next steps we agreed:
- MarketSquare to confirm top-up transaction ID when executed (Olga/Tom)
- We hold off on the canary dunning email while top-up pending; set a reminder to re-evaluate on 2028-06-27 09:00 PST.
- Marcus will prepare the CFO note template in case we need exec escalation after 27-Jun.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Ops Program Manager
Redwood Inference
